ranks: Lorwyn Eclipsed (ECL, 2026-01-23): the rest of the set

blocked.name: Aquitect's Defenses
blocked.why: The Aura's enters trigger 'enchanted creature gains hexproof until end of turn' needs an untargeted effect reference to the permanent the source is attached to; grant-keyword takes only a target slot, source or trigger object (only phase-out has attachedToSource).

blocked.name: Blossombind
blocked.why: 'When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature' has no effect ref for the host, and 'can't become untapped and can't have counters put on it' has no static (doesntUntap covers only its own untap step; nothing stops counters being put).

blocked.name: Brambleback Brute
blocked.why: '{1}{R}, Remove a counter from this creature' takes a counter of any kind, the player choosing; AbilityCost.removeCounter names one fixed kind.

blocked.name: Burdened Stoneback
blocked.why: '{1}{W}, Remove a counter from this creature' takes a counter of any kind, the player choosing; AbilityCost.removeCounter names one fixed kind.

blocked.name: Catharsis
blocked.why: "If {W}{W} was spent to cast it" / "if {R}{R} was spent" need a count of each colour spent; manaSpentColors is only the set of colours (as Vibrance, Wistfulness, Emptiness).

blocked.name: Deceit
blocked.why: 'If {U}{U} was spent to cast it' / 'if {B}{B} was spent to cast it' need a per-colour count of mana spent (manaSpentColors records only which colours); same blocker as Vibrance, Wistfulness, Emptiness.

blocked.name: Deepway Navigator
blocked.why: "As long as you attacked with three or more Merfolk this turn": the `attackers` turn stat counts every creature declared as an attacker and takes no filter, so it can't count Merfolk.

blocked.name: Feed the Flames
blocked.why: "If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead": no effect sets up a this-turn die-to-exile replacement on a target (for any reason, the ruling — as Bot Bashing Time).

blocked.name: Figure of Fable
blocked.why: The third ability's 'protection from each of your opponents' (rule 702.16k, protection from a player) isn't expressible: protection is colours, card types and object filters only; the first two abilities would be animate with setSubtypes and permanent duration.

blocked.name: Foraging Wickermaw
blocked.why: "Add one mana of any color. This creature becomes that color until end of turn": add-mana's `also` side effect can't read the colour the player picked, and animate's setColors is a fixed list.

blocked.name: Gnarlbark Elm
blocked.why: '{2}{B}, Remove two counters from this creature' takes counters of any kinds, the player choosing; AbilityCost.removeCounter names one fixed kind.

blocked.name: Hovel Hurler
blocked.why: '{R/W}{R/W}, Remove a counter from this creature' takes a counter of any kind, the player choosing; AbilityCost.removeCounter names one fixed kind.

blocked.name: Illusion Spinners
blocked.why: 'You may cast this spell as though it had flash if you control a Faerie' — no card field gives a spell conditional flash from its own text (only Molten Exhale's behold kicker).

blocked.name: Loch Mare
blocked.why: 'Remove a counter' / 'Remove two counters from this creature' are any kind, the player choosing; the removeCounter cost takes one fixed kind.

blocked.name: Meek Attack
blocked.why: 'A creature card with total power and toughness 5 or less' has no CardFilter clause (power and toughness compare separately only).

blocked.name: Moonlit Lamenter
blocked.why: 'Remove a counter from this creature' is any kind, the player choosing; the removeCounter cost takes one fixed kind.

blocked.name: Perfect Intimidation
blocked.why: Mode 1 'target opponent exiles two cards from their hand' needs an effect where that player chooses cards from their own hand to exile, and mode 2 'remove all counters from target creature' needs a remove-every-kind effect (remove-counter takes one named kind).

blocked.name: Pitiless Fists
blocked.why: 'When this Aura enters, enchanted creature fights up to one target creature' needs the fight's first creature to be the Aura's host, and no EffectTargetRef names the enchanted creature.

blocked.name: Prismabasher
blocked.why: Vivid's 'up to X target creatures you control' fixes the target count at a live count (colors among your permanents) as it triggers; an any-number group's max is only a number or a spell's X.

blocked.name: Puca's Eye
blocked.why: 'Then choose a color. This artifact becomes the chosen color' on its enters trigger's resolution: no effect chooses a colour and sets a permanent's colour (chooseOnEnter is as-enters, a different timing).

blocked.name: Reaping Willow
blocked.why: 'Remove two counters from this creature' is any kind, the player choosing; the removeCounter cost takes one fixed kind.

blocked.name: Rime Chill
blocked.why: Vivid's 'costs {1} less to cast for each color among permanents you control': CostReductionAmount has no colorsAmong count; the rest (Homesickness's tap-and-stun shape, draw) is expressible.

blocked.name: Sanar, Innovative First-Year
blocked.why: Vivid's "reveal until you reveal X nonland cards" (reveal-until stops at the first match), then "for each of those colors, you may exile a card of that color from among the revealed cards" before shuffling, castable this turn.

blocked.name: Slumbering Walker
blocked.why: "You may remove a counter from this creature. When you do, ...": remove-counter takes one fixed kind, and the creature may carry other kinds (+1/+1, shield, ...) whose choice is the player's.

blocked.name: Spiral into Solitude
blocked.why: "{1}{W}, Blight 1, Sacrifice this Aura: Exile enchanted creature": no EffectTargetRef names the creature the sacrificed Aura enchanted (Uneasy Alliance's blocker).

blocked.name: Squawkroaster
blocked.why: 'Power is equal to the number of colors among permanents you control' is a CDA working in every zone (the ruling); setBasePtFromCount's CountSpec has no colorsAmong, and grantPtPerCount would be 0 off the battlefield.

blocked.name: Swat Away
blocked.why: "The owner of target spell or creature puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library" (put-on-library has a fixed position, the owner isn't asked), and the "{2} less if a creature is attacking you" condition isn't a StaticCondition.

blocked.name: Sygg's Command
blocked.why: Mode 2 'Creatures target player controls gain lifelink until end of turn': grant-keyword-all has no controlledByTarget (modify-pt-all does) and no filter can name a targeted player.

blocked.name: Taster of Wares
blocked.why: "Target opponent reveals X cards from their hand ... you choose one ... that player exiles it" has no effect form, nor does the cast permission "for as long as you control this creature" with any-type mana.

blocked.name: Wildvine Pummeler
blocked.why: Vivid's 'costs {1} less to cast for each color among permanents you control': CostReductionAmount has no colorsAmong count (selfCostReduction can't read it).
